definitions.aggregation: Each dataset/mode is separate. Diagnostic control replays must not be added to validation as independent observations.
definitions.first_introduction_wait_days: assigned_day of first introduction minus arrived_day; served members only
definitions.pooled_quantile: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p over served waits; repeated individuals in separate worlds are member-world instances.
definitions.unserved: Arrived by decision day 59 with no introduction by the end of that decision horizon; right-censored, not assigned zero waiting time.
